content: .{@-याजिन्@} .²1 sacrificing for oneself or himself. {%m.%} a learned man who studies his own nature and that of the soul (of others) to secure eternal felicity, one who looks upon all beings as self; सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि . समं पश्यन्नात्मयाजी स्वाराज्यमधिगच्छति .. <ls>Ms. 12. 91</ls>.
